title: Holiday & Winter Craft Kit Mega Bundle | 10 Cut and Paste Crafts | Pre-K to 1st
desc:
Save 40% with this bundle of 10 Build-a- craft kits for Pre-K to 1st grade! Each 14-page kit has extra-thick cutting lines, 3 ways to prep (color & cut, colored paper, or classroom bulk), step-by-step directions and a bonus coloring page.

📦 Included:

✔ Build-a-Turkey Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Santa Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Christmas Tree Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Reindeer Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Dreidel Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Menorah Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Snowman Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Mittens Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Penguin Craft Kit

✔ Build-a-Hot Cocoa Craft Kit

🧠 Skills: scissor control, fine motor, shapes, counting/size ordering, following directions.
